faqs.question: How does admission to SGT work?
faqs.answer: SGT’s 2026-27 procedure describes online registration, an application form, a registration payment and an online personal interview. Admission is subject to eligibility and applicable regulatory provisions. Register and select the programme: The official procedure asks applicants to choose a programme or specialisation and generate a brochure number. Complete the application: The procedure specifies a registration fee of INR 1,500 and confirmation by SMS or email. Attend the interview: The 2026-27 page describes an online personal interview before eligible candidates proceed to provisional admission.

faqs.question: How can I contact SGT about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 1800 102 5661. Official admissions: https://sgtuniversity.ac.in/admissions/admission-procedure

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at SGT?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy. The [courses and fees table](/university/sgt-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: Does SGT’s ICAR record include postgraduate agronomy?
faqs.answer: Yes. The audited row prints M.Sc. (Ag) Agronomy as well as B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

faqs.question: What practical attachments are described?
faqs.answer: The B.Sc. page names rural agricultural work, agro-industrial attachment and experiential learning units.

faqs.question: What does the 2026-27 application procedure cost?
faqs.answer: The university procedure specifies INR 1,500 for registration.

faqs.question: Is an interview described?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 2026-27 procedure describes an online personal interview before provisional admission.

faqs.question: Are the course-page fees confirmed for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The undergraduate page gives INR 87,500 per semester without a year. This has not been treated as a dated 2026-27 quotation.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at SGT?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy. The [courses and fees table](/university/sgt-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SGT?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters). A full-time, in-person programme whose published structure includes field, rural and industry learning.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at SGT?
faqs.answer: 4 semesters. The agronomy postgraduate course appears in both the university catalogue and audited ICAR row.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SGT?
faqs.answer: Undated course-page eligibility box: 10+2 PCM/PCB/PCMB or agriculture-related subjects with 50%; confirm intake rules.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at SGT?
faqs.answer: Official catalogue: B.Sc. Agriculture or B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture with 55%; catalogue year not stated.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SGT?
faqs.answer: ₹1,75,000 / year · source undated; current intake not confirmed. Undated official annual amount; intake-year applicability is not established. Not a confirmed 2026/2027 quotation. The separate B.Sc. course page shows INR87,500 per semester. Included charges: Published programme fee; other charges are separate unless stated.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at SGT?
faqs.answer: ₹2,50,000 / year · source undated; current intake not confirmed. Undated official annual amount; not a confirmed 2026/2027 quotation. The dedicated masters landing shows INR125,000 per semester for Agronomy. Included charges: Published programme fee; other charges are separate unless stated.

faqs.question: How does admission to SGT work?
faqs.answer: SGT’s 2026-27 procedure describes online registration, an application form, a registration payment and an online personal interview. Admission is subject to eligibility and applicable regulatory provisions. Register and select the programme: The official procedure asks applicants to choose a programme or specialisation and generate a brochure number. Complete the application: The procedure specifies a registration fee of INR 1,500 and confirmation by SMS or email. Attend the interview: The 2026-27 page describes an online personal interview before eligible candidates proceed to provisional admission.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for SGT?
faqs.answer: SGT University: B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 120); M. Sc. (Ag) Agronomy (Intake- 10), recorded term 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at SGT?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience, Agro-Industrial Attachment and experiential learning units are named in the programme description.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SGT?
faqs.answer: Research farm and polyhouses: Named in the undergraduate programme’s practical-learning account.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for SGT?
faqs.answer: Optional campus accommodation: SGT describes separate hostels for boys and girls and says residence is optional. Its undated tariff lacks an explicit period, so no annual room price is inferred. Day-scholar transport: Students apply for pickup point and route through ERP; the transport team approves the request and issues a bus pass. Health and student support: The FAQ identifies access to SGT Hospital, counselling and mental-health support for hostel residents.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SGT?
faqs.answer: The agriculture masters landing explicitly excludes M.Sc. Ag. Agronomy from its displayed postgraduate merit-scholarship scheme. Other listed agriculture/horticulture programmes have UG-mark-based tuition concessions on that page. B.Sc. applicants and Agronomy applicants should obtain the policy for their own programme rather than assume those awards apply. Agriculture masters merit scheme: Agronomy exclusion: M.Sc. Ag. Agronomy is expressly excluded from the landing page’s postgraduate merit scheme. The page is undated and does not establish an award for a B.Sc. Agriculture applicant.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for SGT?
faqs.answer: SGT University publishes an Agriculture and Allied Sectors submission for NIRF 2026. Its programme-duration cohorts report the graduating group, students placed, students entering higher studies and the median salary of placed graduates. These historical institutional submissions are not a placement promise or a salary estimate for every student or individual specialisation.
